name: electronext
description: Modern Electron boilerplate powered by Next.js, Tailwind CSS v4, and Redux Toolkit

scripts.dev: node scripts/check-port.mjs && npm run build:electron && concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http://localhost:3000 && concurrently --kill-others "tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --watch --preserveWatchOutput" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run clean:sourcemaps && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run clean:sourcemaps && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run clean:sourcemaps && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run clean:sourcemaps && electron-builder --linux
